title: American Tourister Applite 5 Suitcase, 50cm $107.99 (RRP $220) Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: American Tourister Applite 5 Suitcase, 50cm $107.99 (RRP $220) Delivered @ Amazon AU

[sol3x] Just wanted to point out that these Applite 5 series are not stackable if you want to invest in other sizes. The designer probably just didn't think it through. Good price nonetheless, these go for 50% off at Myer/DJ from time to time, too.
[olderman] Fair point, I have 2 other suitcases which I stack, but then I realised that I haven't used the big one, which is probably 82cm, in ages and honestly I don't want to use it anymore, as it's just way too big :) so kind of downsizing, but you're right, I already thought damn how am I going to store them
[kevst] Just for those that don't know - American Tourister is owned by Samsonite.
Usually a cheaper option with very similar quality.
[olderman] Btw, I know it’s subjective, but same size Samsonite looks worse :) Myer has only models with 4 wheels and they are so tiny and flimsy, can’t imagine what it feels like to use them on any surface outside of airport.
[fredblogs] 2 wheels is good but I don't know why they couldn't make that 55cm as well. 50cm seems too small
[Carrera1963] From memory they're the same volume, the 55cm is just taller because of the wheels.
[olderman] They are now, and you’re right, it’s because of the wheels, but if they made the wheels recessed, as all 2-wheelers are, the same 55cm size model would be able to hold more.
[Carrera1963] Maybe the 55 is too big for some airlines?
[muwu] @Carrera1963: The 50cm has dimensions within Jetstar allowances, the 55cm does not.
Its not the height (up to 56cm), it's the width (up to 23cm), as the 50 is 22cm wide and the 55 is 25cm wide
[browser] Are typical sets of three usually: 55m, 65cm, 75cm?
50cm is a little small?
[compound] So torn between hardcase and softcase luggages.
[olderman] Hmm, torn? Sounds like you're in softcase territory then. If you're cracking though, it's hardcase.
